_about: DEMO DATA: a made-up guided-diagnosis plan for the demo car (screenshots and tests). The example.com links are placeholders.

plans.symptom: Squeal when braking in the morning
plans.title: Demo Sedan: brake squeal (demo plan)
plans.intro: Three checks, cheapest first (demo plan). Most morning squeal is surface rust; worn pads and dry slide pins come next.
plans.safety_overview: Never get under or reach behind a wheel of a car held only by a jack: use jack stands on firm ground. Brakes are safety-critical: if the pedal feels soft or the car pulls, stop driving it.

causes.name: Surface rust on the rotors (normal)
causes.fix: Nothing: it wipes off in a few stops

causes.name: Pads down to the wear indicator
Dry caliper slide pins or worn shims
causes.fix: Clean and grease the slides; new shims

steps.title: When does it squeal?
safety: Do this on a quiet street, not in traffic.
steps.do: Drive a few blocks first thing in the morning and count the stops until the squeal goes away.
steps.look_for: Whether the squeal stops after a few stops or keeps going all day.

options.label: Gone after a few stops
options.means: Classic surface rust: normal, especially after rain (demo).

options.label: Squeals all day
options.means: Not just rust: look at the pads and slides next.

steps.title: Look at the pad thickness
steps.do: Turn the steering wheel all the way and look through the wheel spokes at the outer front pad.
steps.look_for: How thick the pad material is (a new pad is about 10 mm; under 3 mm is worn out).

options.label: Thin (3 mm or less) or metal tab touching
options.means: The wear indicator is squealing: time for pads (demo).

steps.title: Check the caliper slide pins
safety: Car on jack stands, never only on the jack.
Don't press the brake pedal with a caliper off.
steps.do: Remove the wheel and the two caliper slide bolts, pull the pins and look at them.
steps.look_for: Pins that are dry, rusty or hard to slide.

options.label: Dry, rusty or sticky
options.means: Sticky slides make pads drag and squeal (demo).
